Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that there was a stage adaptation of "South of the Border" based on inconclusive and ambiguous search results. The WebSurfer consistently reported a lack of definitive evidence for a stage adaptation of any film titled "South of the Border," and the results pointed to unrelated works or the 2009 Oliver Stone documentary. Despite this, the Planner inferred that a stage adaptation existed without sufficient evidence. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect assumption that both "Buried Country" and "South of the Border" were films turned into stage performances, resulting in an erroneous conclusion to the real-world problem.
